title: Britecharts scatterPlot spec
description: A scatterPlot chart: the chart's name, its configuration (the accessors, commands and events the scatterPlot wrapper takes) and its data.

a11yDataTable.description: Gets or Sets whether the chart renders its data as a table that screen readers can read, row by row and cell by cell. The table is visually hidden, placed right after the svg and linked from it with `aria-details`; its caption is the chart's name. On by default: set it to false for an app that gives the data its own accessible form.

a11yDescription.description: Gets or Sets a longer description screen readers announce after the name, such as what the data shows. It is rendered as the svg's `<desc>` and linked with `aria-describedby`. Unset, there is no description.

a11yTitle.description: Gets or Sets the name screen readers announce for the chart. It is set as the svg's `aria-label`. Unset, the getter reads `null` and the chart is announced by its type, such as "Bar chart".

animationDuration.description: Gets or Sets the duration of the animation

circleOpacity.description: Gets or Sets the circles opacity value of the chart. Use this to set opacity of a circle for each data point of the chart. It makes the area of each data point more transparent if it's less than 1.

circleStrokeOpacity.description: Gets or Sets each circle's border opacity value of the chart. It makes each circle border transparent if it's less than 1.

circleStrokeWidth.description: Gets or Sets each circle's border width value of the chart. It makes each circle border transparent if it's less than 1.

colorMap.description: Gets or Sets the colorMap of the chart.

colorSchema.description: Gets or Sets the colorSchema of the chart

customBrushEnd.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customBrushStart.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customClick.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customMouseMove.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customMouseOut.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customMouseOver.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

enableZoom.description: Gets or Sets weather the chart support zoom controls. `false` by default. If `true`, zoom event handling will be added to the chart.

exportChart.description: Executes a command that triggers the download of the current chart: an svg file when the filename ends in `.svg`, and a png otherwise

grid.description: Gets or Sets the grid mode.

hasCrossHairs.description: Gets or Sets the hasCrossHairs status. If true, the hovered data point will be highlighted with lines and legend from both x and y axis. The user will see values for x under x axis line and y under y axis. Lines will be drawn with respect to highlighted data point

hasHollowCircles.description: Gets or Sets the hasHollowCircles value of the chart area

hasTrendline.description: Gets or Sets the hasTrendline value of the chart area If true, the trendline calculated based off linear regression formula will be drawn

height.description: Gets or Sets the height of the chart

highlightTextLegendOffset.description: Sets a custom distance between legend values with respect to both axises. The legends show up when hasCrossHairs is true.

isAnimated.description: Gets or Sets the isAnimated property of the chart, making it to animate when render. Ignored when the reader's system asks for reduced motion

isLoading.description: Gets or Sets the loading state of the chart

margin.description: Gets or Sets the margin object of the chart (top, bottom, left and right)

maxCircleArea.description: Gets or Sets the maximum value of the chart area

valueLocale.description: Gets or Sets the locale which our formatting functions use. Check [the d3-format docs]{@link https://github.com/d3/d3-format#formatLocale} for the required values.

width.description: Gets or Sets the width of the chart

xAxisFormat.description: Exposes ability to set the format of x-axis values

xAxisFormatType.description: Exposes ability to set the formatter of x-axis values The `timeFormat` formatter function is applied if a custom `xAxisFormatType` that is not equal to 'number' is provided

xAxisLabel.description: Gets or Sets the xAxisLabel of the chart. Adds a label bellow x-axis for better clarify of data representation.

xAxisLabelOffset.description: Gets or Sets the offset of the xAxisLabel of the chart. The method accepts both positive and negative values.

xTicks.description: Gets or Sets the xTicks of the chart

yAxisFormat.description: Exposes ability to set the format of y-axis values

yAxisLabel.description: Gets or Sets the y-axis label of the chart

yAxisLabelOffset.description: Gets or Sets the offset of the yAxisLabel of the chart. The method accepts both positive and negative values.

yTicks.description: Gets or Sets the yTicks of the chart
